_about: Patristic and spiritual works ingested from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL), which publishes these public-domain texts for download as ThML. Add a work here and run `npm run data:all` to ingest it. `scriptureMode` says how verse links are derived: 'tractates' / 'psalm-roman' / 'john-dot' read the work's own section titles (structure-based, strongest); 'tags' uses scripture references tagged inside the text (machine-tagged: the text cites the passage, it is not necessarily a commentary on it).

works.description: A Jewish-born Anglican scholar sets the Gospels in their world and gathers rabbinic readings of the Old Testament as messianic (see his appendices). A Protestant author of the 19th century: read for its Jewish background, not for doctrine.
works.translator: Original English (1883); CCEL text from the Eerdmans 1953 printing
works.rightsEvidence: Edersheim died 1889; first published 1883; CCEL rights field: Public Domain. The CCEL text follows a 1953 reprint, which may carry editorial matter; only Edersheim's own text is used.

works.title: The Temple: Its Ministry and Services
works.author: Alfred Edersheim
works.description: Sacrifices, priesthood, festivals and the daily service of the Second Temple as described in the Mishnah and Josephus: background for the Eucharist, the Passover and the letter to the Hebrews.
works.translator: Original English (London, 1874; Hodder and Stoughton 1904 printing)
works.rightsEvidence: Edersheim died 1889; first published 1874; CCEL rights field in the file.

works.title: Sketches of Jewish Social Life
works.author: Alfred Edersheim
works.description: Family, synagogue, school and village life in the time of Jesus.
works.translator: Original English (1876; 1904 printing)
works.rightsEvidence: Edersheim died 1889; CCEL rights field: Public Domain.
